pages.text: $(bold)Drops$(): 2-6x $(item)blaze rod$(), 0-13x $(item)blaze powder$()$(br)and nether-related items (check next page);$(br)

In this ritual a $(#ad03fc)Blaze$() is spawned with energy of $(#ad03fc)The Nether$() and immediately$(br)possessed by the summoned $(#ad03fc)Djinni$(). The $(#ad03fc)Possessed Blaze$() is immune to water and snowball!$(br2)Extra Drops:$(br2)Always one of $(item)$()

nether wart$(), $(item)crimson fungus$(), $(item)warped fungus$(),$(br)$(item)red mushroom$(), $(item)brown mushroom$(), $(item)crimson roots$(),$(br)$(item)warped roots$(), $(item)weeping vines$(), $(item)twisting vines$();$(br)

Usually one of $(item)netherrack$(), $(item)nether quartz ore$(), $(item)crimson nylium$(),$(br)$(item)warped nylium$(), $(item)nether wart block$(), $(item)warped wart block$();$(br2)Generally one of $(item)soul sand$(), $(item)soul soil$(), $(item)basalt$(),$(br)$(item)blackstone$(), $(item)gravel$(), $(item)bone block$(), $(item)gilded blackstone$();$()

$(br)Sometimes one of $(item)glowstone dust$(), $(item)magma block$(), $(item)glowstone$(), $(item)shroomlight$();$(br2)Occasionally one of $(item)obsidian$(), $(item)crying obsidian$(), $(item)ancient debris$();$(br)
